message:
I have a friend who tends to panic at the first sign of trouble. Whenever there’s a storm warning, she’s already packing her bags and making plans to flee. I always tell her that being prepared doesn’t mean being scared; it’s just about knowing what to do when things go a little sideways. 

I came across a handy resource that lays out simple steps for making a family emergency plan. It’s all about having a calm approach, so you can feel ready instead of rattled when unexpected things pop up. 

Sometimes, just knowing you have a plan can take the edge off. What’s your favorite way to prepare for the unexpected?
